items.author: neubig
items.body:
**What problem or use case are you trying to solve?**

Sometimes models fail to do their job correctly, and we would benefit from starting all over from the beginning. There are a few examples of this in the agent literature:
- Aider recently introduced a [harness](https://github.com/paul-gauthier/aider-swe-bench) for testing SWE-bench that allows for retries when tests and linting don't pass on swe-bench
- @Jiayi-Pan has work on [Evaluation and Refinement for web agents](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.06474) that use a reward model to judge when a web task has failed, a reset mechanism to return
items.title: [Feature]: Retry on failure functionality
